documents.text:
Subject: Account blocked with NO warning - where are my wages??

Hi,

On Thursday (24th) my card was declined at the petrol station and when I logged into the app it said my account is 'restricted' and to call you. I rang on Saturday and the man ([STAFF_1] I think) said a decision had been made to close my account and that I was sent a letter at the start of August giving me 60 days notice. I NEVER got any letter. I've lived at the same flat for 3 years and I get all my other post fine.

My wages went in on the 25th (£1,742) and I can't touch them. I've had to borrow money off my mum for food and petrol and my rent is due on the 1st. Nobody will tell me why my account is being closed, he just said it was 'a business decision' and he couldn't say any more.

I've banked with you since I was 16. I haven't done anything wrong.

I want:
1. my wages released to me now. I've opened an account with another bank and can give you the details
2. a copy of this so called letter
3. to know why, and if you are closing it, to be given the proper notice like you're supposed to

[CUSTOMER]
[CUSTOMER_PHONE]

30/07/26 Account review outcome: EXIT - business decision (ref ER-2207). Notice period 60 days. CL60 closure notice letter sent 01/08/2026 to address on file. Account to close 30/09/2026. - Customer Review team
26/09/26 Inbound call, [CUSTOMER]. Cust disputes receiving closure letter. Advised decision stands, CL60 sent 01/08 per CRM. Cust upset re wages. Advised cannot disclose reasons. - [STAFF_1]
29/09/26 Email complaint logged. Called cust [CUSTOMER_PHONE] at 14:10, no answer, VM left. - [STAFF_2]

Account [ACCOUNT] event history 01/07/2026 - 28/09/2026:

25/08/2026 FP IN GBP 1,738.90 BLAKEMORE CARE LTD PAYROLL

24/09/2026 08:41 CARD [CARD] BLOCKED
25/09/2026 06:02 FP IN GBP 1,742.18 BLAKEMORE CARE LTD PAYROLL - HELD (account restricted)
Correspondence events in period: none
Scheduled closure date: 24/11/2026
